snapshot.text: Statutory health insurance system with several insurance funds. The new government's health ministry is putting primary care, prevention and system modernisation first, and has agreed a new cooperation plan with WHO.

priorities.title: Stronger primary care
priorities.text: The minister's first six months focused on strengthening primary care, modernising the health system and structural changes.

priorities.title: New cooperation plan with WHO
priorities.text: The ministry and WHO presented a new cooperation plan aimed at a more resilient health system.

priorities.title: Medicine availability in the EU
priorities.text: In Luxembourg the minister pressed for better availability of medicines and support for innovation in Europe.
